Auric Defense.name: Auric Defense
Auric Defense.description:
The character gains three abilities that they can utilize. 
As a swift action, the character gains a HP barrier equal to one-quarter of their maximum natural HP. The barrier lasts until the beginning of the character's next turn. 
As a swift action, the character gains two placed roles on all resistance checks until the start of their next turn. 
As a swift action, the character can create an indestructible 5' x 5' barrier within 60' LOS, remaining for as long as they maintain focus. The character can move any number of these barriers using their swift action, up to 30'. Any projectile with a ranged attack roll passing through the barrier is immediately destroyed. The barrier counts as an exceptionally protective cover.

Countermeasures.name: Countermeasures
Countermeasures.description: The character gains access to several actions that allows them to defend themselves against an opponent's attacks. \nAs a reaction, the character can reduce the damage of an incoming ranged attack by 1d10/P. If the damage is reduced to 0, they can catch the projectile, should they have a free hand, redirecting it at a target within 50' by making an attack roll, inflicting the attack's damage on a successful hit. \nAs a reaction, the character can redirect a missed attack roll against them to a target within their weapon's melee reach.

Defensive Maneuvers.name: Defensive Maneuvers
Defensive Maneuvers.description: The character can take up a defensive position. \nAs a swift action, the character selects a target to protect within the range/reach of their weapon. When the protected target is the target of an attack roll, the character may make a strike against the attacker. All combatants have a displaced roll when making ranged attack rolls against the protected target. \nAs a swift action, the character can choose a 5-10' radius within their weapon's range/reach (this radius must be within your normal attack range/reach). Whenever someone moves through this area the character may choose to make a free strike against them.

Dodging.name: Dodging
Dodging.description: The character has their movement DVs set to 15 + 1/P, though they forgo the usage of armor and shields (No benefit from DVs when wearing a shield or armor.) This DV gain is active so long as the character maintains focus. \nAs a reaction, the character can contest the attack roll of an incoming attack if it is higher than the attack roll, they negate the strike. \nAs a reaction to a target missing the character with an attack roll, they may make a strike against the opponent if they are within reach/range.

Immaculate Deftness.name: Immaculate Deftness
Immaculate Deftness.description:
The character gains access to a number of abilities that aid them in deftly crossing the battlefield unscathed. 
The character becomes immune to stun and paralysis 
The character halves the damage of any effect requiring an AGI check. If they succeed at the check, the damage is instead negated. If the check is failed, the damage is halved. 
As a swift action, the character can take up a defensive stance. Attack rolls cannot have placed rolls against them, nullifying all effects that grant them.

Lifelink Aura.name: Lifelink Aura
Lifelink Aura.description: As a swift action, the character extends their life force to up to 10 other targets. Should the targets take any damage, the damage is transferred to the character instead. This effect lasts as long as the character retains focus. The character cannot benefit from immunity while this ability is active.

Mitigative.name: Mitigative
Mitigative.description:
The character has become adept at defending themselves and those around them, they can... 
As a reaction, block an attack roll aimed at a target within 10' by granting them 3 bonus DVs; this DV bonus only applies to the single attack roll. 
As a reaction, decrease a source of mundane damage directed at a target within 5' by 1d8/P. 
As a reaction, rush over to an ally within 10', forcing the attack rolls of a single target to be against the character instead.

Perfect Defense.name: Perfect Defense
Perfect Defense.description: Standing behind the character now confers the same benefits as standing behind cover, nullifying the need for taking a swift action to do so. They can extend this ability to 10' on either side of themselves as a Swift Action - effectively becoming a wall, as a jut of opaque energy extends on either side. This effect lasts as long as the character retains focus. The character is always considered to be in normal cover as long as they are in their armor and have a shield.

Relentless Defender.name: Relentless Defender
Relentless Defender.description: The character becomes adept at unorthodox defensive maneuvers, gaining access to several reactions. When a target gets within melee reach of the character... \nAs a reaction, they can make a melee attack roll against an incoming target, with 1MP/P. \nAs a reaction, take a movement action.

Shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
Shieldbearer.description:
The character can defend themselves more adequately with a shield. 
As a core action, the character takes on a defensive stance, gaining resistance to all damage until the start of their next turn. The character can utilize a swift action to make a strike, using up to half of their maximum MP when doing so. 
As a swift action, the character can charge up to their land movement, making a melee attack roll against a target, knocking them prone on hit. 
These abilities are only usable while wielding a shield; The character gains a stacking placed roll on all HEA saves/checks while wielding one as well.

Steady Hand.name: Steady Hand
Steady Hand.description: The character has learned how to zero in on a target's weak points, given time. \nIf the character is in cover, or they have not moved since their last round, they gain a placed roll on their first attack roll made during their turn. \nTaking cover no longer takes an action
